messages.subject: No-main Models
parts:
Dan,

The parser can do two things to the Stan program example.stan. Firstly it can generate a cpp with a main
that compiles into an executable. Secondly it can generate a cpp without a main that’s useful for including
as a header. In that second case shouldn’t the parser generate example.hpp instead of example.cpp?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] No-main Models
parts:
So... It can't do the first anymore.

For the second, I think it makes sense to do generate an hpp file.
